items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions John Chilton's books; Interviewee confirms facts from the Chilton book but does not describe a personal relationship with Chilton.

ctx.x:
P R O C E E D I N G S
June 12, 1976. Interview with Lawrence Brown.

Well now, let's start with correcting your birth date. I think you said you were looking at the Feather John Chilton's Who's Who of Jazz and Leonard Feather's Encyclopedia of Jazz, and which one is the right one?
Well, there have been several errors from time to time. I guess I gave out the wrong information from time to time, but my real birth date is August the 3rd, 1907. That's in the Chilton book.
